taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

traits.height_typical_m.note: FEIS's western rattlesnake plantain review (Reeves 2006, read 2026-10-15): stems "are 4 to 18 inches (10-45 cm) tall".

traits.leaf_length_m.note: FEIS's western rattlesnake plantain review (Reeves 2006, read 2026-10-15): leaves "thick, entire, and broadly lance-shaped, 1 to 4 inches (3-10 cm) long on winged petioles".

traits.leaf_habit.note: FEIS's western rattlesnake plantain review (Reeves 2006, read 2026-10-15): "a native perennial, evergreen forb" whose leaves persist.

traits.rosette.note: FEIS's western rattlesnake plantain review (Reeves 2006, read 2026-10-15): "The persistent leaves are arranged in a basal rosette".

traits.perennation.note: FEIS's western rattlesnake plantain review (Reeves 2006, read 2026-10-15): "arising from short creeping rhizomes".

traits.inflorescence.note: FEIS's western rattlesnake plantain review (Reeves 2006, read 2026-10-15): flowers "borne on a 1-sided or spiraled raceme".

traits.units_per_inflorescence.note: FEIS's western rattlesnake plantain review (Reeves 2006, read 2026-10-15): "There are as many as 30 flowers/raceme, but 10 to 15 are more common".

traits.inflorescence_length_m.note: A model estimate (confidence high) of 5-13 cm, its top held to the 12 cm FEIS gives as the most ("up to 5 inches (12 cm) long", Reeves 2006).

traits.fruit_size_m.note: FEIS's western rattlesnake plantain review (Reeves 2006, read 2026-10-15): "The fruit is an erect, pubescent capsule about 0.4 inch (1 cm) long".

traits.flowering_months.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as the FEIS review read gives no months for the Northwest.

generator.params.note: White bog orchid's values, changed by hand for rattlesnake plantain: a basal rosette (FEIS, Reeves 2006) drawn as six leaves held nearly flat, as in research-grade iNaturalist photos (read 2026-10-17), 2-5 small leaves low on the stem drawn as 3, and a dense raceme of 14 small flowers, as long as its stated inflorescence (the bog orchid's 16 cm raceme, longer than the 12 cm FEIS gives, no longer set by hand). Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: 40 cm to the top of the flowering stem at 4 years, within FEIS's 10-45 cm stems (Reeves 2006). Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: By eye, after FNA (Kallunki, vol. 26): blade "usually streaked with white only along midrib, sometimes with fine white lateral veins, especially near midrib", reticulate and plain leaves in one clone; and research-grade iNaturalist photos (read 2026-10-17): dark blue-green rosette leaves, a greyish-white midrib stripe on every leaf, on some plants white veinlet dashes beside it or a full net of veins round dark areoles, a dark rim kept, plain paler undersides. Drawn as the veins variegation on the upper face only, its share varying between leaves. Small greenish-white hooded flowers (FEIS, Reeves 2006). Each flower's place on the raceme is 0.118 of its length, so its capsule is the 1 cm FEIS gives on the 8.5 cm raceme its stated length gives.

traits.fruiting_months.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as the FEIS review read gives no months.

traits.leaf_width_m.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L91873), as no source read gives it.

traits.leaf_shape.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L91873), as no source read gives it.

traits.leaf_apex.note: FNA, Goodyera oblongifolia (read 2026-10-18): the tip is acute.
